note: Ironhold Mortar (unit identity, Ironclad): a scorch-bearded gunner, iron cap, goggles, leather apron, a brass-hooped mortar tube on a back pack board and a powder keg. Tier II brass cap band, spaulder lame and boss, bracers, knee plates, tube hoops; tier III spaulder spikes, greaves, an ember comb, brass trunnions. No back flag.
